label: Act Like a Pop Star: B

lines.text: Four hours earlier, in Enikk's room.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: All tests are now complete.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Thank you for your cooperation.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I appreciate all your hard work.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Initiating physical condition scan.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Scan complete. No abnormalities detected, aside from poor hygiene.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Well... I haven't even been able to go outside for days with all these tests.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: So, what's the verdict?

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Highly suitable.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: The plan you proposed is executable.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Minor errors may occur, but no critical issues expected.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Which would mean...

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: In theory, there is no issue.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: However, the subject's consent is required.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I thought as much.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Affirmed. This plan cannot proceed without consent.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Consent obtained through coercion, including physical force, is invalid.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: The subject's voluntary consent is required.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: What happens after we obtain their consent?

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Upon consent, the process will proceed immediately.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: The estimated duration is five minutes.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: That's fast.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Correct.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... Understood.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I'll see to it that I have their consent.
Hanson checks his watch and strides out of Enikk's room.
T.T. STAR's performance is in two hours.
In a VIP room at Tetra Line's private hospital.
Mustang lies in bed, staring up at the ceiling.
At last, the day has come. The cure for the disease that's been eating away at him is ready.
He's lost count of how long he's waited for this.
He lets his eyes fall shut, a faint smile lingering on his lips.
He waits.
The hospital room door opens without a sound.
Footsteps draw closer.
His heart starts to pound faster and faster, as if it might burst from his chest.
The footsteps stop. Someone stands beside him.
A feeling he hasn't known in a long time rises within him, a mix of anticipation and nerves. Slowly, he opens his eyes.
And when he finally sees the face he's been waiting for, his smile spreads wider.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: So, you've finally arrived,

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: my son.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Yes, Father.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I'm here.
In Hanson's hand is a small mechanical device,
a pale white liquid sloshing faintly inside.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: So this is the cure.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Yes, that's correct.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: How'd you even get your hands on that... No, no, that's a boring question.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: So, what now?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: You're standing there with my life in your grip.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Go on, tell me what do you plan to do with it?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Father,

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I ask that you die.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Anis.
Yoyo suddenly closes in.
The stench is enough to make anyone wince.
She gnaws at her nails, flashing a crooked grin as she speaks.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: So you're finally going mainstream, huh? Must be nice.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: After everything you did to me, you still get to make it big. Happy now?

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Yoyo... you've got it wrong. I didn't do that.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I'm really sorry about what happened to you.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: But it wasn't me. It wasn't us.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: That's not the kind of thing we'd ever do.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Heh, and that Smile Time thing counts as acting like a pop star?

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: Did you come to pick a fight?

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: Save it for after the show. We'll hear you out then.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: This is an important day for us. So do me a favor and step back.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Hey, Anis.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Back in school, you took everything from me.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: You had nothing, yet you couldn't stand that I had it all. So you just took it.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: And that still wasn't enough? Now you've even become a Nikke... What, you planning to take everything again?

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: ... No, that's my line.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Oh, so you're saying it was all just a misunderstanding, huh?

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: But we can't exactly clear that up, can we? We're both seeing things our way.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: So I was thinking...

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Why don't we just pretend none of this ever happened?

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: ... What?!

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Yeah, let's pretend none of this ever happened.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Let's go back to when we were students.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: And this time, we do it fair and square.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Did you get shot or something? What the heck are you on about?

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: If we could go back, I wouldn't pick on you anymore.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: So you stay in your place and keep your hands off what's mine.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Then we wouldn't have to fight...

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: and you wouldn't end up on that rooftop.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: You knew about that?

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Ah, yeah. I've been watching, waiting to see when you'd go up.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Anyway, if we're starting over, you'd better keep it fair this time.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: I gave it some thought, and the reason we're even in this mess is because we came from such different worlds, right?

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: You had nothing, and I had everything.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: So, if we both start with nothing, then there'd be no reason to fight, right?

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Heh, makes sense, right? Pretty genius, don't you think?

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: So no hiding behind your groupmates or anything like that.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Just you and me. Nothing else. A proper competition.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: And this time, I'll show you exactly how wide the gap really is.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: You're out of your damn mind.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: One's already been dealt with, so now it's just the two of you.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Sorry, but would you mind leaving? Anis and I have a score to settle.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Wait... what?

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Come on, it's only a fair match if both of them step out. Why are you so surprised?

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Wait, you said you took one out... What does that even mean?

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Your manager, who else? I've already killed her. Now, I just need to get rid of these two, and then it'll be you and me.
*Wham!*
Anis's fist connects with Yoyo's face.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Urgh!
Yoyo goes down hard.
Something flies from her clothes and skids across the floor.
It's Riss's glasses.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: *Gasp!*

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Wh-why are you hitting me, Ani—
*Wham!*
Anis grabs Yoyo by the collar, yanks her upright, and slams a fist into her face repeatedly.
*Wham, wham, wham, wham!*
Mint and Prika are shouting, but Anis can't hear a thing.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Ack... Ugh... kgh...!

lines.speaker: classpresident
lines.text: You're an orphan!

lines.speaker: classpresident
lines.text: You only got in here on some scholarship!

lines.speaker: classpresident
lines.text: You've got absolutely nothing, so why do you strut around like you're in charge?

lines.speaker: classpresident
lines.text: I'm the leader! I'm the class president! Not you!
*Wham, wham, wham, wham!*

lines.speaker: schoolgirl
lines.text: Uh, hey...

lines.speaker: schoolgirl
lines.text: A-Anis.

lines.speaker: schoolgirl
lines.text: Um...

lines.speaker: schoolgirl
lines.text: D-do you like Pretty?
*Wham, wham, wham, wham!*

lines.speaker: schoolgirl
lines.text: I-I just wanted to say... I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: schoolgirl
lines.text: I've been meaning to... apologize for a while...

lines.speaker: schoolgirl
lines.text: We don't... dislike you. That part's really true... I hope you know that.

lines.speaker: schoolgirl
lines.text: Yeah, i-if you ever become one, I'd want to be your manager.

lines.speaker: schoolgirl
lines.text: It'd be so much fun, traveling around, performing everywhere...

lines.speaker: schoolgirl
lines.text: I-it's not like your goal is just to watch the concert, right?

lines.speaker: schoolgirl
lines.text: You want to learn something from it, right?

lines.speaker: schoolgirl
lines.text: You've been giving it some serious thought, haven't you?

lines.speaker: schoolgirl
lines.text: Then it makes sense for you to go, Anis.
*Wham, wham, wham, wham!*

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: I thought if you ever came looking for me, I should be ready. So I became a manager and worked hard to learn the job.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Because someday, I wanted us to become something special together.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Don't you dare take it out on my pop star! Stay away from her! Don't come anywhere near her, you hear me?!

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Get lost! All of you, just get the hell away!

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: I'm... I'm so sorry! I screwed everything up...!

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: But I can't... I just can't do this anymore...!

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: I hate this...! No, I hate myself...! I can't stand watching you fall apart...!

lines.speaker: classpresident
lines.text: Puh-lease, know your place!

lines.speaker: classpresident
lines.text: Just because everyone humors you doesn't mean they actually like you!
*Wham!*

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Yeah, you're right.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I should've stayed in my place,

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: you damn monster!
*Wham!*

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I just wanted to be loved and to give back even a fraction of the love I was given.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Who did I think I was? Right?

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: You want what I have? You can have it all!
*Wham!*

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I'm done with being a pop star.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I was never meant to be someone special.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: But that was the one thing you shouldn't have taken from me!
*Wham!*

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: You should never have taken my star from me!

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Now, I'm about to do something no pop star would ever do.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I'm going to kill you.
*Wham!*

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Who the hell do you think you are... going after my star?!

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: Anis!

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: That's enough! Stop!

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Let go! Let go of me! I swear I'm gonna kill her!
A rapid burst of camera clicks rings out.
Anis stops punching, then Yoyo drops hard onto the ground.
Her face is so badly beaten that it's unrecognizable.
By now, a crowd has gathered, closing in from all sides.
Every one of them has a phone or camera raised, recording.
*Click, click, click, click, click!*
Anis springs to her feet.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: You enjoying this?!

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Huh?! I'm asking you whether you're enjoying this?!

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Is other people's misery really that entertaining to you?!
Another rapid burst of camera clicks rings out.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Don't look at me...!

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I said don't look at me!

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Stop it!

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Get the hell away from me, you damn animals!
